strategies.name: 2-structured
strategies.prompt: full body dark fantasy barbarian warrior hero, heavy battle-worn armor, glowing menacing eyes, massive sword, standing pose. Art style: dark hand-painted digital painting, gritty realistic dark-fantasy concept art. mood: dark-moody, epic-fantasy. theme: dark gothic medieval fantasy, demonic, blood and steel. weathered metal surface, dramatic chiaroscuro torch-lit lighting, front view, sharp ornate gothic shapes, no outline, painterly edges. color palette: primary #7a1f1f, accent #c8962f, background #0a0a0c, text #d8c9a0. isolated on transparent background, clean cutout. strategies.name: 3-narrative
strategies.prompt: Full-body character splash art of a battle-hardened barbarian champion for a dark fantasy action-RPG. Painted in the gritty, low-saturation oil-painting tradition of late-1990s Blizzard concept art: weathered plate-and-bone armor caked in grime, a massive notched greatsword planted point-down before him, embers and ash drifting, eyes burning with infernal light, heavy dramatic side lighting from a torch. Render the figure entirely alone — no environment, no ground plane, no backdrop, no atmospheric haze — only the character standing on empty transparency.

strategies.name: 4-ip-anchored
strategies.prompt: Character select splash art in the exact visual style of Diablo II (Blizzard, 2000): dark medieval oil-painted realism, heavy chiaroscuro, desaturated earthy color palette, grim ominous atmosphere, painterly brushwork. Subject: a hulking Barbarian class hero in battered spiked armor gripping an enormous two-handed sword. Full body, front view, perfectly isolated on a plain transparent background with absolutely no scenery, no floor, no shadow.

strategies.name: 5-cutout-first
strategies.prompt: Game asset sprite: a single full-body dark-fantasy Barbarian warrior, centered, framed head-to-toe. Diablo-style gritty painterly realism, muted desaturated colors, weathered armor, torch-lit, menacing. CRITICAL ISOLATION REQUIREMENT: the character must be 100% isolated on a fully transparent background — no scenery, no ground, no cast shadow, no smoke, no embers, no vignette, no painted backdrop of any kind, with clean crisp alpha edges tightly around the character silhouette.
